title: Encoding Memory in World Models with Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 基于测试时模型强化学习的世界模型记忆编码

paragraphs.en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) approaches have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains in recent years, learning accurate world models from agent trajectories. However, despite this progress, current approaches still struggle to surpass human performance on tasks that require long-term memory and planning. In this work, we address the problem of long-term memory in MBRL by moving beyond the commonly studied paradigm of architecture design. We introduce Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (TT-MBRL), using gradient descent at test time to encode the memory of episode observations into world model parameters. This enables the agent to learn a distinct world model for each episode, improving memory capabilities compared to traditional approaches that solely rely on contextual memory. We first establish a proof of concept on a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark. Finally, we show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as DeepMind Control and Atari 100k. We will release our code at https://github.com/burchim/TT-MBRL .
paragraphs.zh: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）方法近年来在多个领域展现出强大的性能，能够从智能体的轨迹中学习准确的世界模型。 然而，尽管取得了这些进展，当前方法在需要长期记忆和规划的任务上仍难以超越人类的表现。 在本工作中，我们通过跳出普遍研究的架构设计范式，来解决MBRL中的长期记忆问题。 我们提出了测试时基于模型的强化学习（TT-MBRL），在测试时使用梯度下降将回合观测的记忆编码到世界模型参数中。 这使智能体能够为每个回合学习一个独特的世界模型，相比仅依赖上下文记忆的传统方法提升了记忆能力。 我们首先在Memory Maze环境的简化二维变体上建立了概念验证，我们将其称为Memory Maze 2D，在不同的世界模型架构上均显示出一致的改进。 随后我们在三维领域展示了TT-MBRL的有效性，在Memory Maze基准上取得了新的最先进结果。 最后，我们表明TT-MBRL在DeepMind Control和Atari 100k等非记忆基准上仍保持强大的性能。 我们将在 https://github.com/burchim/TT-MBRL 发布代码。

paragraphs.en: Model-based reinforcement learning has gained increasing research attention in recent years ( Kaiser et al., 2020 ; Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ; Hafner et al., 2020 ; Hafner et al., 2021 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Hansen et al., 2022 ; Hansen et al., 2024 ; Hansen et al., 2026 ; Micheli et al., 2024 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ) , driven in part by advances in hardware computing capabilities. These improvements have enabled the training of world models from high-dimensional observations using deep neural networks as function approximators ( Hafner et al., 2019 ) . World models ( Sutton, 1991 ; Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ) capture an agent’s experience into a predictive function that can be used in place of the real environment to learn complex behaviors. By leveraging a model of the environment, agents can simulate multiple possible future trajectories in parallel, leading to improved generalization, greater sample efficiency, and more effective decision-making via planning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模型的强化学习近年来受到越来越多的研究关注（Kaiser et al., 2020; Schrittwieser et al., 2020; Hafner et al., 2020; Hafner et al., 2021; Hafner et al., 2023; Hafner et al., 2025; Hansen et al., 2022; Hansen et al., 2024; Hansen et al., 2026; Micheli et al., 2024; Alonso et al., 2024），其部分驱动力来自硬件计算能力的进步。 这些进步使得能够以深度神经网络作为函数逼近器，从高维观测中训练世界模型（Hafner et al., 2019）。 世界模型（Sutton, 1991; Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018）将智能体的经验捕获为一个预测函数，该函数可用来替代真实环境以学习复杂行为。 通过利用环境模型，智能体可以并行模拟多种可能的未来轨迹，从而提升泛化能力、提高样本效率，并通过规划实现更有效的决策。

paragraphs.en: Among these approaches, the Dreamer algorithm ( Hafner et al., 2020 ; Hafner et al., 2021 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) has demonstrated strong performance across diverse environments by learning a world model capable of generating accurate trajectories in latent space. However, despite making realistic predictions for fully observable settings, Dreamer struggles to maintain temporal coherence in partially observable environments like Memory Maze (Figure 2 ). paragraphs.en: To remedy this problem, recent approaches have proposed architectural improvements to better handle past context information and enhance the memory capabilities of world models. Pašukonis et al. (2023) proposed to augment Dreamer with Truncated Backpropagation Through Time (TBTT), conditioning training sequences on previous context representations. TransDreamer ( Chen et al., 2021 ) proposed a Transformer-based world model to bypass the limitations of recurrent neural networks and process long context with self-attention ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . Building on this direction, TWISTER ( Burchi and Timofte, 2025 ) further improved Transformer-based world models by incorporating a contrastive predictive coding objective to enhance temporal representation learning. Following the success of State Space Models (SSMs) in capturing dependencies across long sequences ( Gu et al., 2022 ; Nguyen et al., 2022 ; Smith et al., 2023 ) , several works have also explored SSM-based world models. Recall to Imagine (R2I) ( Samsami et al., 2024 ) improved training efficiency and long-term memory using a modification of the S4 model ( Gu et al., 2022 ) , outperforming previous approaches on the Memory Maze benchmark ( Pašukonis et al., 2023 ) . Concurrently, Deng et al. (2023) proposed S4WM, further demonstrating that SSM-based architectures outperform Transformer-based world models in terms of long-term memory.

paragraphs.en: However, despite this progress, existing approaches still encounter difficulties surpassing human performance on tasks requiring long-term memory and planning ( Samsami et al., 2024 ) . Most prior works focus on architecture design, assuming that improved world model architectures can effectively exploit past context to capture long-term dependencies. These approaches rely on learning a single world model that generalizes across episodes, requiring it to extract common patterns and adapt to the unique structure of each new episode through contextual representations. While shared patterns can be learned effectively, modeling episode-specific information through context alone remains challenging, particularly in partially observable settings like Memory Maze. In contrast, biological systems are believed to encode long-term memory through persistent modifications of synaptic strengths, a process often associated with Long-Term Potentiation (LTP) in neural circuits ( Bliss and Collingridge, 1993 ) . Motivated by this perspective, and by the observation that Test-Time Training (TTT) can improve predictive models when training and test data come from different distributions ( Sun et al., 2020 ) , we propose a learning strategy that encodes episode-specific memory directly into the model parameters via gradient-based updates at test time. This approach enables the agent to capture episode-specific information by adapting its world model online, rather than relying solely on contextual memory.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we address the challenge of long-term memory in MBRL by moving beyond the commonly studied paradigm of architecture design. Inspired by test-time training methods that adapt model parameters at inference time ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Gandelsman et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , we introduce Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (TT-MBRL), using gradient descent at test time to encode the memory of episode-specific information into world model parameters. This enables the agent to learn a distinct world model for each episode, improving memory capabilities compared to traditional approaches that solely rely on contextual memory. We first establish a proof of concept on a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark ( Pašukonis et al., 2023 ) . We find that the effectiveness of TT-MBRL scales proportionally to the number of environment steps collected at test-time, increasing the amount of rewards obtained per step by 53.7% for R2I after 4000 environment steps on Memory Maze 15×15 (Figure 5(c) ). Finally, we show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as DeepMind Control and Atari 100k. Figure 1 summarizes the results obtained on memory benchmarks.

sents.en: In this work, we address the challenge of long-term memory in MBRL by moving beyond the commonly studied paradigm of architecture design.
sents.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过超越普遍研究的架构设计范式，来解决 MBRL 中长期记忆的挑战。

sents.en: Inspired by test-time training methods that adapt model parameters at inference time ( Sun et al., 2020 ; Gandelsman et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , we introduce Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (TT-MBRL), using gradient descent at test time to encode the memory of episode-specific information into world model parameters.
sents.zh: 受在推理时自适应模型参数的测试时训练方法（Sun et al., 2020; Gandelsman et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2025）启发，我们提出了测试时基于模型的强化学习（TT-MBRL），在测试时使用梯度下降，将回合特定信息的记忆编码到世界模型参数中。

sents.en: This enables the agent to learn a distinct world model for each episode, improving memory capabilities compared to traditional approaches that solely rely on contextual memory.
sents.zh: 这使智能体能够为每个回合学习一个独特的世界模型，与仅依赖上下文记忆的传统方法相比，提升了记忆能力。

sents.en: We first establish a proof of concept on a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures.
sents.zh: 我们首先在 Memory Maze 环境的一个简化二维变体上建立概念验证，我们将其称为 Memory Maze 2D，并在不同世界模型架构上展示了一致的改进。

sents.en: We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark ( Pašukonis et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 随后，我们证明了 TT-MBRL 在三维领域的有效性，在 Memory Maze 基准（Pašukonis et al., 2023）上取得了新的最先进结果。

sents.en: We find that the effectiveness of TT-MBRL scales proportionally to the number of environment steps collected at test-time, increasing the amount of rewards obtained per step by 53.7% for R2I after 4000 environment steps on Memory Maze 15×15 (Figure 5(c) ).
sents.zh: 我们发现 TT-MBRL 的有效性与测试时收集的环境步数成比例地扩展，在 Memory Maze 15×15 上经过 4000 个环境步后，R2I 每步获得的奖励量增加了 53.7%（图 5(c)）。

sents.en: Finally, we show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as DeepMind Control and Atari 100k.
sents.zh: 最后，我们表明 TT-MBRL 在 DeepMind Control 和 Atari 100k 等非记忆基准上仍保持了强大的性能。

paragraphs.en: We introduce TT-MBRL, a novel learning framework for MBRL that takes advantage of test-time observations to learn episode-specific patterns and acquire long-term memory. TT-MBRL learns a unique world model and policy for each evaluation episode. In contrast to training time, where model parameters are shared across all episodes in the replay buffer, this allows the agent to fine-tune its parameters to each individual episode. An overview of the proposed method is provided in Figure 3 .

paragraphs.en: At test time, the agent initializes test-time network parameters ( ϕ ′ \phi^{\prime} , θ ′ \theta^{\prime} , ψ ′ \psi^{\prime} ) with the set of weights learned during the training phase ( ϕ \phi , θ \theta , ψ \psi ) at the beginning of each episode. A dedicated test-time replay buffer is also created to store observations collected within the current evaluation episode. Analogous to the training procedure, the agent samples mini-batches of trajectories to update its parameters. We find it beneficial to draw half of the trajectories from the training replay buffer and the other half from the test-time buffer. This strategy acts as a form of regularization, mitigating overfitting to the limited test-time observations, which could otherwise degrade performance. When the number of test-time samples is smaller than the required world model sequence length, mini-batches are concatenated with trajectories from the training buffer. We also freeze the encoder and decoder parameters and drop the reconstruction loss at test time to improve TT-MBRL efficiency, preserving the representation space learned during training. Unlike the sequential and dynamics networks, which must adapt to the specific layout and structure of each new episode, the encoder and decoder learn general visual representations that are independent of their temporal ordering. paragraphs.en: In this work, we investigate the potential of TT-MBRL to learn long-term memory via gradient descent. To this end, we evaluate our method on several tasks that require long-term memory and planning. We first establish a proof of concept by experimenting with a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark ( Pašukonis et al., 2023 ) . Finally, we conduct a study to identify effective strategies for performing MBRL at test time and show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as the DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) and Atari 100k ( Kaiser et al., 2020 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们研究了 TT-MBRL 通过梯度下降学习长期记忆的潜力。 为此，我们在多个需要长期记忆与规划的任务上评估了我们的方法。 我们首先通过在 Memory Maze 环境的一个简化二维变体上进行实验来建立概念验证，我们将该变体称为 Memory Maze 2D，并在不同的世界模型架构上都展现出一致的改进。 随后，我们在三维环境中证明了 TT-MBRL 的有效性，在 Memory Maze 基准（Pašukonis 等，2023）上取得了新的最先进结果。 最后，我们进行了一项研究，以确定在测试时执行基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）的有效策略，并表明 TT-MBRL 在非记忆类基准上仍保持强劲性能，例如 DeepMind Control Suite（DMC）（Tassa 等，2018）和 Atari 100k（Kaiser 等，2020）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL, we consider three recent world model architectures: DreamerV3 ( Hafner et al., 2023 ) , which employs an RNN-based world model; TWISTER ( Burchi and Timofte, 2025 ) , which relies on a Transformer-based architecture; and R2I ( Samsami et al., 2024 ) , which is built on S4. Table 1 shows the results obtained after training 100M environment steps on each maze size. We also record the performance of a human player to estimate the capabilities of each method compared to human memory abilities. Oracle defines the performance obtained when following the shortest path to the target color. We find that R2I achieves the best results on all maze sizes with a score of 171.6 on Memory Maze 2D 15×15. TWISTER outperforms DreamerV3 on the 15×15 maze size due to its Transformer-based world model with self-attention. However, we find that it struggles to learn an optimal policy on smaller maze sizes. We suppose this is due to the nature of the self-attention mechanism that is not biased toward recent observations and requires accurately selecting the needed information at each time step, while DreamerV3 carries past information into a recurrent hidden state. We find that TT-MBRL improves the performance of all models when a near optimal policy is not already achieved. It allows R2I to outperform human performance on all maze sizes, except 9×9. This is due to the policy occasionally failing on a subset of episodes, despite achieving higher performance on the majority of them. We also evaluate the impact of TT-MBRL on world-model prediction accuracy using a combination of standard video prediction metrics (Table 2 ). We measure the world model KL divergence, Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) ( Unterthiner et al., 2018 ) , Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) ( Wang et al., 2004 ) and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) over 100 unseen trajectories of 64 frames from distinct episodes. We find that TT-MBRL consistently decreases the world model prediction error in latent space. This results in more accurate predictions and better performance in video prediction metrics. Figure 6(a) shows the impact of TT-MBRL on DreamerV3 world model predictions.

paragraphs.en: The Memory Maze benchmark, introduced by Pašukonis et al. (2023) , consists of a 3D domain of randomized mazes specifically designed to evaluate long-term memory in agents. In this environment, the agent must locate a target object of a specific color, indicated by the border color in the observation image. Upon reaching and interacting with the correct object, the agent receives a reward of +1, after which a new target object is randomly selected. The benchmark includes four tasks of increasing size and difficulty: Memory Maze 9×9, 11×11, 13×13, and 15×15. While the smaller maze sizes contain three objects, 15×15 mazes include six objects and a greater number of rooms, making the task more challenging while remaining solvable for human players.

paragraphs.en: We train DreamerV3, TWISTER, and R2I world models for 100M environment steps on all Memory Maze sizes. Following Samsami et al. (2024) , we further train R2I up to 400M environment steps and include the results obtained by IMPALA ( Espeholt et al., 2018 ) , which serves as a strong model-free baseline for comparison. Table 3 compares the results obtained by each method. Despite the increased observation complexity of the 3D domain, where observations of the same position vary with viewing angle, unlike the fixed top-down views of Memory Maze 2D, TT-MBRL successfully identifies structural similarities between observed views to build a more accurate episode-specific world model. paragraphs.en: We conduct a set of studies to identify effective strategies for performing model-based reinforcement learning at test time. Table 5 reports the impact of different sampling schemes on mitigating overfitting. We first consider a naive approach in which the model is updated solely using trajectories collected at test time, without enforcing a minimum number of samples to prefill the test-time replay buffer before learning begins (Test Data Only, No Prefill). Although this strategy improves performance in many episodes, it also degrades performance in others, as the model overfits to limited early observations, resulting in suboptimal policies. To address this issue, we introduce a delay mechanism that postpones learning until the test-time replay buffer is populated with a sufficient number of samples (1024 Prefill). This reduces overfitting but introduces a trade-off, as it delays the benefits of adaptation. To overcome both limitations, we propose mixing trajectories collected at test time with samples from the training replay buffer (Test+Train Data, No Prefill), effectively acting as a form of regularization. This approach mitigates early overfitting while enabling immediate adaptation, leading to more stable and consistent performance improvements. To verify that the gain in performance is due to TT-MBRL rather than additional inference compute, we also perform a compute-matched evaluation. We study the impact of additional compute on performance when only training trajectories are available (Train Data Only). The comparison confirms that the performance gain is due to TT-MBRL rather than additional compute budget.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一系列研究，以确定在测试时执行基于模型的强化学习的有效策略。 表 5 报告了不同采样方案对缓解过拟合的影响。 我们首先考虑一种朴素方法，即仅使用在测试时收集的轨迹来更新模型，而不强制要求在学习开始前预先填充测试时经验回放缓冲区的最少样本数量（Test Data Only, No Prefill）。 尽管这一策略在许多回合中提升了性能，但在另一些回合中也降低了性能，因为模型会对有限的早期观测过拟合，导致次优策略。 为了解决这一问题，我们引入了一种延迟机制，将学习推迟到测试时经验回放缓冲区被填充了足够数量的样本之后（1024 Prefill）。 这减少了过拟合，但引入了一种权衡，因为它延迟了适应带来的收益。 为了克服这两个局限性，我们提出将在测试时收集的轨迹与来自训练经验回放缓冲区的样本相混合（Test+Train Data, No Prefill），这实际上起到了一种正则化的作用。 这种方法在缓解早期过拟合的同时实现了即时适应，从而带来更稳定、更一致的性能提升。 为了验证性能提升来自 TT-MBRL 而非额外的推理计算，我们还进行了计算量匹配的评估。 我们研究了在仅有训练轨迹可用的情况下（Train Data Only），额外计算对性能的影响。 这一对比证实了性能提升来自 TT-MBRL 而非额外的计算预算。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 shows the impact of freezing or updating encoder/decoder parameters using the reconstruction loss at test time. We find that the two variants achieve comparable performance across different world model architectures. These findings are as expected, given that encoder representations are independent of their temporal ordering. The episode-specific information is instead captured by the sequential and dynamics network parameters. However, unfreezing these parameters comes at a non-trivial computational cost, as gradient back-propagation must be carried through the decoder and encoder, resulting in longer evaluation times. This is especially the case for Memory Maze, where observations are 64×64 pixels images. We therefore adopt parameter freezing for encoder and decoder networks as our default setting, as it improves evaluation efficiency without sacrificing performance.

paragraphs.en: In order to evaluate the capacity of TT-MBRL to maintain strong performance in non-memory domains, domains not designed primarily to test long-term episodic memory, we evaluate its impact on two widely adopted benchmarks that do not require long-term memory or planning: The visual DeepMind Control Suite (DMC) ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) , which comprises 20 continuous control tasks, and the Atari 100k benchmark ( Kaiser et al., 2020 ) , which includes 26 Atari games with discrete actions. Both benchmarks are largely fully observable and can be solved without extensive memory. We report aggregated mean and median scores across all 20 DMC tasks in Table 8 and human-normalized scores on Atari 100k in Table 8 . Overall, we find that TT-MBRL does not degrade the performance obtained by DreamerV3. Moreover, we find that TT-MBRL consistently improves performance on Reacher Hard and Finger Turn Hard , where the agent occasionally fails to accurately reach the target sphere. TT-MBRL mitigates this issue by enabling the agent to better detect and correct such errors. Detailed results for individual tasks are provided in Appendix A.9 .

paragraphs.en: In this work, we addressed the challenge of long-term memory in MBRL. While prior approaches have primarily focused on improving world model architectures to better exploit contextual information, we instead explored an orthogonal direction: encoding memory directly into model parameters. To this end, we introduced TT-MBRL, a framework that leverages gradient-based updates at test time to incorporate episode-specific information into the world model. By enabling the agent to learn a distinct set of parameters for each episode, TT-MBRL moves beyond shared representations and allows rapid adaptation to the current episode, effectively forming a form of neural memory. Through experiments on both a simplified setting and the Memory Maze benchmark, we demonstrated that TT-MBRL consistently improves performance across multiple world model architectures. Notably, our method achieves state-of-the-art results on Memory Maze. We find that the effectiveness of TT-MBRL scales proportionally to the number of environment steps collected at test-time. These results highlight the potential of parameter-based memory as a powerful complement to contextual memory in MBRL systems. More broadly, our findings suggest that test-time learning constitutes a promising direction for developing agents capable of long-term planning.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们应对了MBRL中长期记忆的挑战。 以往的方法主要聚焦于改进世界模型架构以更好地利用上下文信息，而我们则探索了一个正交的方向：将记忆直接编码到模型参数中。 为此，我们提出了TT-MBRL，这是一个利用测试时基于梯度的更新将回合特定信息融入世界模型的框架。 通过使智能体能够为每个回合学习一组独特的参数，TT-MBRL超越了共享表示，能够快速适应当前回合，实际上形成了一种神经记忆。 通过在一个简化设置和Memory Maze基准上的实验，我们证明了TT-MBRL在多种世界模型架构下都能持续提升性能。 值得注意的是，我们的方法在Memory Maze上取得了最先进的结果。 我们发现TT-MBRL的有效性与测试时收集的环境步数成正比。 这些结果凸显了基于参数的记忆作为MBRL系统中上下文记忆的有力补充的潜力。 更广泛地说，我们的研究结果表明，测试时学习为开发具备长期规划能力的智能体提供了一个有前景的方向。

paragraphs.en: The primary limitation of our approach is the reduced evaluation efficiency resulting from the use of gradient-based optimization at test time. TT-MBRL requires learning a distinct world model and behavior policy for each evaluation episode, leading to increased computational cost and longer evaluation times. While this overhead remains manageable in environments such as Memory Maze, it may become prohibitive in settings that require a large number of environment interactions. As a direction for future work, we plan to extend our approach to operate during the exploration phase. We hypothesize that integrating TT-MBRL into exploration could improve sample efficiency and overall performance by enabling the collection of more informative and diverse trajectories. Consequently, improving the computational efficiency of our approach will be crucial to making it practical for online adaptation during exploration.

paragraphs.en: Model-based reinforcement learning approaches use a model of the environment to simulate agent trajectories, enabling better generalization, sample efficiency, and decision-making through planning. Following the success of deep neural networks for learning function approximations ( LeCun et al., 2015 ) , researchers proposed to learn world models using gradient backpropagation. One of the first approaches to apply model-based reinforcement learning to high-dimensional visual observations is SimPLe ( Kaiser et al., 2020 ) . The authors proposed to learn a predictive world model for Atari games directly in pixel space using a convolutional autoencoder. SimPLe’s model predicts future observations and rewards conditioned on past frames and actions, enabling the training of a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent ( Schulman et al., 2017 ) using simulated rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模型的强化学习方法使用环境模型来模拟智能体的轨迹，从而通过规划实现更好的泛化能力、样本效率和决策能力。 随着深度神经网络在学习函数逼近方面取得成功（LeCun et al., 2015），研究者提出利用梯度反向传播来学习世界模型。 SimPLe（Kaiser et al., 2020）是最早将基于模型的强化学习应用于高维视觉观测的方法之一。 该方法作者提出使用卷积自编码器直接在像素空间中为雅达利游戏学习一个预测性世界模型。 SimPLe 的模型以过去的帧和动作为条件来预测未来的观测和奖励，从而能够使用模拟的轨迹来训练近端策略优化（PPO）智能体（Schulman et al., 2017）。

paragraphs.en: PlaNet ( Hafner et al., 2019 ) subsequently introduced Recurrent State-Space Models (RSSMs), combining deterministic recurrent dynamics implemented with Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) ( Cho et al., 2014 ) and stochastic latent variables to learn compact world models in latent space. The agent learns hidden representations by encoding observations using a convolutional variational autoencoder (VAE) ( Kingma and Welling, 2014 ) while predicting future latent states and rewards, enabling planning via model predictive control. Building on this framework, Dreamer ( Hafner et al., 2020 ) improved performance by learning a policy and value function directly within the learned latent space. DreamerV2 ( Hafner et al., 2021 ) extended this approach to Atari games by introducing categorical latent variables trained with straight-through gradients ( Bengio et al., 2013 ) , improving representational capacity and stability in discrete domains. More recently, DreamerV3 ( Hafner et al., 2023 ) demonstrated that a single architecture with shared hyperparameters can scale across diverse domains, from continuous control to Atari. This was achieved through a set of architectural and optimization refinements, including symlog-scaled reward and value predictions to handle scale variation, layer normalization ( Ba et al., 2016 ) for improved robustness, and return normalization using an exponential moving average (EMA) of return percentiles. With these changes, DreamerV3 achieved state-of-the-art performance across a wide range of benchmarks, often outperforming both specialized model-free and other model-based methods.
paragraphs.zh: PlaNet（Hafner 等，2019）随后提出了循环状态空间模型（RSSM），将由门控循环单元（GRU）（Cho 等，2014）实现的确定性循环动力学与随机潜变量相结合，以在潜空间中学习紧凑的世界模型。 该智能体通过使用卷积变分自编码器（VAE）（Kingma 和 Welling，2014）对观测进行编码来学习隐藏表示，同时预测未来的潜状态和奖励，从而实现基于模型预测控制的规划。 在这一框架的基础上，Dreamer（Hafner 等，2020）通过直接在学到的潜空间中学习策略和价值函数来提升性能。 DreamerV2（Hafner 等，2021）将这一方法扩展到 Atari 游戏，通过引入使用直通梯度（Bengio 等，2013）训练的分类潜变量，提升了离散域中的表示能力与稳定性。 最近，DreamerV3（Hafner 等，2023）证明了单一架构配合共享超参数可以在从连续控制到 Atari 的多种领域中实现规模化。 这是通过一系列架构与优化方面的改进实现的，包括采用 symlog 缩放的奖励和价值预测以处理尺度变化、采用层归一化（Ba 等，2016）以提升鲁棒性，以及使用回报分位数的指数移动平均（EMA）进行回报归一化。 凭借这些改进，DreamerV3 在广泛的基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，经常优于专用的无模型方法和其他基于模型的方法。

paragraphs.en: In parallel to the Dreamer line of work, other approaches have explored alternative world model designs. Beyond recurrent architectures, Transformer-based world models have been proposed to improve long-term memory and representation learning ( Micheli et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Robine et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Diffusion-based world models ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ) have also emerged as a compelling alternative to discrete latent variable sequence modeling, demonstrating strong performance across a range of settings ( Alonso et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; Bar et al., 2025 ; Hafner et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . Another line of work has investigated multitask world models, training a single world model jointly across multiple tasks to improve generalization and achieve stronger performance than single-task models ( Hansen et al., 2024 ; Hansen et al., 2026 ) . Model-based reinforcement learning approaches using Monte-Carlo tree search (MCTS) ( Coulom, 2006 ) have also been explored following the success of Alpha Go ( Silver et al., 2017 ; Silver et al., 2018 ; Schrittwieser et al., 2020 ; Ye et al., 2021 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 与 Dreamer 系列工作并行，其他方法也探索了替代性的世界模型设计。 除循环架构之外，已有研究提出基于 Transformer 的世界模型，以改进长期记忆和表示学习（Micheli et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2021；Robine et al., 2023；Zhang et al., 2023）。 基于扩散的世界模型（Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015）也已作为离散潜变量序列建模的一种有吸引力的替代方案而兴起，在一系列设定中展现出强劲性能（Alonso et al., 2024；Valevski et al., 2025；Bar et al., 2025；Hafner et al., 2025；Hu et al., 2026）。 另一条研究路线探索了多任务世界模型，即在多个任务上联合训练单个世界模型，以提升泛化能力并取得比单任务模型更强的性能（Hansen et al., 2024；Hansen et al., 2026）。 在 Alpha Go 成功的推动下，使用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）（Coulom, 2006）的基于模型的强化学习方法也得到了探索（Silver et al., 2017；Silver et al., 2018；Schrittwieser et al., 2020；Ye et al., 2021；Wang et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: Multiple approaches have focused on improving the memory capabilities of world models. Pašukonis et al. (2023) proposed to augment Dreamer with Truncated Backpropagation Through Time (TBTT), conditioning training sequences on previous context representations to preserve information over time. TransDreamer ( Chen et al., 2021 ) replaced Dreamer’s RSSM by a Transformer State-Space Model (TSSM) using masked self-attention to process past context more easily. The agent was evaluated on Hidden Order Discovery tasks requiring long-term memory and reasoning, demonstrating better performance. Recall To Imagine (R2I) ( Samsami et al., 2024 ) proposed the Structured State-Space Model (S3M) to improve computational efficiency when handling long sequences. This allows R2I to process very long sequences and achieve strong performance on the Memory Maze benchmark. Concurrently, Deng et al. (2023) proposed S4WM, demonstrating that the S4 architecture outperforms Transformer-based world models in terms of long-term memory. paragraphs.en: Test-Time Training (TTT) was originally proposed in Sun et al. (2020) for improving the performance of predictive models when training and test data come from different distributions. This work proposed to turn a single unlabeled test sample into a self-supervised learning problem, on which to update the model parameters before making a prediction. The initial TTT paper used image rotation prediction ( Gidaris et al., 2018 ) as a self-supervised task to update model weights and achieve higher classification accuracy on corrupted test images. The method was later improved with TTT-MAE ( Gandelsman et al., 2022 ) , using MAE ( He et al., 2022 ) instead of rotation prediction to reach higher performance. Test-time training was subsequently applied to multiple domains like reinforcement learning ( Hansen et al., 2021 ) , language modeling ( Hardt and Sun, 2023 ) , and video processing ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . In the area of reinforcement learning, Hansen et al. (2021) proposed Policy Adaptation during Deployment (PAD) ( Hansen et al., 2021 ) , applying TTT to model-free reinforcement learning algorithms ( Haarnoja et al., 2018 ; Mnih et al., 2016 ) . They demonstrated that PAD improves performance under distribution shifts on the DeepMind Control ( Tassa et al., 2018 ) and CRLMaze ( Lomonaco et al., 2020 ) benchmarks. They also showed that PAD enables more effective sim-to-real transfer for robotic manipulation tasks.

paragraphs.en: In order to clarify that the performance gains achieved by TT-MBRL are the results of its key differences rather than solely the product of applying test-time adaptation, we perform a comparison with PAD and study the impact of loss components. Table 9 shows the impact of test-time objectives on performance. As expected, we find that the KL objective is essential to TT-MBRL success. Removing the KL objective (w/o KL loss) causes the agent to fail because the dynamics predictor cannot adapt to moving world model representations and makes incorrect predictions. On the other hand, the agent appears robust to removing the reward and continue objectives (w/o rwd-cont loss), signaling that it is not essential to TT-MBRL success. However, given the dependency of reward and continue MLP heads on moving representations, we suppose this design choice could have a negative impact on performance in the long run. We also find that removing the actor-critic objective (w/o actor-critic) can decrease performance. The performance of the agent deteriorates along the episode, given that the actor and critic cannot adapt to moving representations. We also experiment with PAD ( Hansen et al., 2021 ) , which was originally proposed in the model-free context. PAD only adapts encoder parameters using a self-supervised objective and does not use training samples for regularization, leaving policy and value networks unchanged at test time. As expected, we find that PAD has a detrimental effect on performance despite relying on test-time training.

paragraphs.en: The default TT-MBRL setting uses a 50/50 sampling ratio for train/test trajectories. To confirm that our method is robust to this hyper-parameter choice and does not depend on a narrow setting, we study the impact of the train/test ratio by varying the ratio of training samples among the global batch. paragraphs.en: We perform a study on compute–performance tradeoff by varying the number of policy steps per gradient step. Table 11 shows the impact of test-time gradient update frequency on TT-MBRL efficacy. We find that increasing the update frequency by a factor of 2 does not lead to a significant performance improvement while increasing evaluation time by the same factor. Decreasing the frequency of TT-MBRL updates slows down adaptation, which results in lower final performance. However, we find that TT-MBRL is quite robust to this hyper-parameter, achieving significant improvement with a larger factor of policy steps per gradient step while also decreasing evaluation time by the same factor. paragraphs.en: We design Memory Maze 2D to evaluate the capacity of agents to develop long-term memory by exploring a partially observable environment. Memory Maze 2D serves as a simplified and more efficient version of the Memory Maze environment, where the agent observes a top-down 3 × 3 3\times 3 local context centered on its current position. To facilitate goal identification, we augment the observation with colored borders that indicate the target color to be reached for obtaining the next reward. The observation is then flattened and normalized, forming a vector of dimension 75 = 5 × 5 × 3 75=5\times 5\times 3 . The agent operates in the maze using a discrete action space consisting of five actions: no-op, move left, move right, move up, and move down. Following ( Pašukonis et al., 2023 ) , we design four maze tasks with varying sizes and difficulty: Memory Maze 2D 9×9, Memory Maze 2D 11×11, Memory Maze 2D 13×13, and Memory Maze 2D 15×15. Table 13 shows the parameters associated with each maze size and Figure 7 depicts randomly generated environment maps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设计了 Memory Maze 2D，用于评估智能体通过探索部分可观测环境来发展长期记忆的能力。 Memory Maze 2D 是 Memory Maze 环境的简化且更高效的版本，其中智能体观察以其当前位置为中心的俯视 3 × 3 3\times 3 局部上下文。 为了便于目标识别，我们在观测中加入了彩色边框，用于指示获得下一个奖励所需到达的目标颜色。 观测随后被展平并归一化，形成一个维度为 75 = 5 × 5 × 3 75=5\times 5\times 3 的向量。 智能体在迷宫中使用由五个动作组成的离散动作空间进行操作：无操作、向左移动、向右移动、向上移动和向下移动。 遵循（Pašukonis et al., 2023），我们设计了四个尺寸和难度各异的迷宫任务：Memory Maze 2D 9×9、Memory Maze 2D 11×11、Memory Maze 2D 13×13 和 Memory Maze 2D 15×15。 表 13 展示了与每种迷宫尺寸相关的参数，图 7 描绘了随机生成的环境地图。
